intro: Lesson 68: Revision: direct and inverse proportion. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Core: d ∝ t² and d = 20 when t = 2. (a) Write d in terms of t (b) Find d when t = 3 (c) Find t when d = 125 (t > 0)
Extend : Light intensity I is inversely proportional to the square of the distance d. I = 36 when d = 2. Find I when d = 3, and d when I = 4.
Stretch: y ∝ 1/√x. x is multiplied by 4. What happens to y?
questions.a: y = k/√x: √x doubles, so y halves (a 50% decrease)

questions.q: F is inversely proportional to d². F = 20 when d = 3. Find F when d = 6.
p ∝ √q and p = 12 when q = 16. Find p when q = 49.
6 workers take 10 days. How long would 4 workers take at the same rate?
y ∝ x³. What happens to y when x doubles?
y ∝ x² and y = 12 when x = 2. Write the formula.
